 Confirmed Sevilla and Alavés line-ups for LALIGA matchweek 12 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Sevilla and Alavés have announced their confirmed lineups for Matchday 12 of LALIGA. 
 Luis García Plaza's starting XI features some changes. He heads into the match without Miguel Sierra and Marcao (injured), as well as Manu Bueno (sent off against Getafe). The changes to the lineup see Sangante come into defence and Rubén Vargas take a spot on the wing. The other nine players retain their places at the Coliseum.

 🚨 Nuestro XI para medirnos al @Alaves ⚪️🔴
Odysseas, Juan Iglesias, Sangante, Kike Salas, Suazo, Fofana, Agoumé, Vargas, Isaac, Félix y Stassin.
#SevillaAlavés | #WeAreSevilla | #NuncaTeRindas  –  Friday, 6 November 2026 
 Meanwhile, Quique Sánchez Flores has virtually his entire squad available as he looks for a much-needed win.
